title: Bug 2006549 - Restrict localised folder names to those with specific names. r=aleca,edicharry This takes us back to an earlier version¹ but with the addition of a few more names. There's also now a preference, mail.useLocalizedFolderNames, which can be used to disable localised folder names on remote folders. Changing this preference requires a restart.
